notes.title: New update - Chill mode, inverted camera and more!
notes.content:
✅ Reverse camera option
✅ Chill mode added (full version)
✅ New hidden button to make the frog scream 🐸
✅ Improved tongue physics
✅ Texture bugs fixed
✅ On keyboard, the R key is now used to respawn
